records.title: Worst-case low-rank approximations
records.reason: The paper proves worst-case guarantees for low-rank PCA/matrix-completion estimators and evaluates simulations and environmental applications. It concerns robust statistics across domains, not neural model compression or LLM inference.

records.title: PoseRWGCN: an attention-free dual-stream RWKV-GCN architecture for real-time 3D human pose estimation
records.reason: The publisher full text describes PoseRWGCN: RWKV temporal stream plus GCN spatial stream for 3D human-pose sequences, with causal and bidirectional modes; on two pose datasets it reports 62.1% fewer FLOPs than its baseline. The evaluation is task-specific pose estimation and supplies no language-model result or transferable LLM serving test.

records.title: Enhancing Vision Language Corruption Robustness using Cross-Distribution & Prompted Denoisers
records.reason: Primary publisher record https://doi.org/10.1109/WACV61042.2026.00558 returned an internal error; full-text retrieval was not available. The available abstract concerns VLM corruption robustness/denoising and does not establish the linked MoE inference relevance.

records.title: Recursive Inference Machines for Neural Reasoning
records.reason: Recursive Inference Machines combine a neural backbone with an explicit recursive inference scheme and report gains on ARC-AGI and Sudoku tasks. The paper does not establish lower compute, latency, or memory than its baselines; it is a possible reasoning-inference architecture connection, but efficiency relevance is unproven.

records.title: When Sensors Fail: Temporal Sequence Models for Robust PPO under Sensor Drift
records.reason: PPO robustness to sensor failures in control policies; not language-model inference or model serving.
